apps.name: Fluxa
apps.subtitle: Your media, in one place.
apps.versionDescription:
## What's Changed

- feat(player): open the track and sync panels as bottom sheets on mobile (`06a67a3d`)
- feat(skin): add a form media feature for the device form factor (`8c1dd5b5`)
- feat(skin): fill the player icons and the active navigation icon (`4aaeadf7`)
- fix(ui): paint padded text inside its padding (`000f0b99`)
- fix(settings): reload on source change and fall back when the provider is disconnected (`93f065a4`)
- feat(simkl): build continue watching cards from Simkl art, episode titles and order (`84aa1ad0`)
- fix(skin): show an empty progress track on continue watching cards (`6fa0556f`)
- fix(skin): highlight the Home pill on the detail screen (`b0ffe3f4`)
- fix(ui): size rows and columns by the wrapped height of the text inside (`1ed27eeb`)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/FluxaMedia/fluxa/compare/v0.3.12...v0.3.13
